subject: Initial phone screen — candidate travel day conflict & ICS timezone fix
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Asha Venkat <asha.venkat@gmail.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 21:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial phone screen for Senior Engineer (30m)

Hi Asha —

Thanks for applying to Redwood Inference and for the quick intro on your profile. We'd love to schedule a 30-minute phone screen so you can meet Irene (hiring manager) and we can learn more about your background.

Quick ask: are you available for any of these 30-minute windows (PT / converted below):
- Tue Jul 21, 10:00–10:30 PT (19:30–20:00 IST)
- Wed Jul 22, 08:30–09:00 PT (17:00–17:30 IST)
- Wed Jul 22, 16:00–16:30 PT (01:30–02:00 IST next day)

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and what timezone you are in right now — I know candidates sometimes travel and calendars get weird. I’m including a short pre-read on the role (attached).

Irene, looping you in — flexible on which window works best for you.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SR-Engine-PreRead.pdf (pdf)]
From: Asha Venkat <asha.venkat@gmail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:42:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Initial phone screen for Senior Engineer (30m)

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — I’m excited about the role. I’m currently traveling and in transit between Mumbai (IST) and Amsterdam (CEST) on Tue/Wed. My availability in local times is:
- Tue Jul 21 local: 09:00–11:00 CEST (I’m in Amsterdam after 18:00 IST)
- Wed Jul 22 local: 20:00–22:00 CEST

I can do a 30-minute chat during either block, but note that on Tue I’ll be on a train in the morning (spotty connection). If we lock a time, please send an ICS with the timezone attached — my calendar app has been switching the event to IST automatically when I accept.

I prefer Irene as the primary interviewer if that helps with scheduling.

Cheers,
Asha Venkat
Senior Software Engineer
asha.venkat@gmail.com
+44 7700 123456
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Asha Venkat <asha.venkat@gmail.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial phone screen for Senior Engineer (30m)

Hi Asha —

Appreciate the heads-up about travel and the calendar quirk.

Irene is good to be primary. Given your windows, would 10:30–11:00 CEST on Tue Jul 21 work for a 30-minute phone screen? That maps to 01:30–02:00 PT — I realize that’s early for our side, so if that’s awkward we can shift to Wed 20:30 CEST (11:30 PT) instead. Please confirm which you prefer.

I’ll send a calendar invite with an explicit timezone tag and Google Meet link once you confirm. Marissa — can you please watch for the ICS to ensure the event lands in Irene’s calendar correctly? We had an incident last week where an invite converted to IST and clobbered the interviewer’s morning block.

Attaching the role pre-read again and I'll include a dedicated ICS file in the invite to avoid auto-conversion.

Thanks,
Vivek
[Attachment: SR-Engine-PreRead.pdf (pdf), to be re-sent as vivek-calendar-invite.ics]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial phone screen for Senior Engineer (30m)

On Sun, Jul 19, 2026 at 10:50 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> I’ll send a calendar invite with an explicit timezone tag and Google Meet link once you confirm. Marissa — can you please watch for the ICS to ensure the event lands in Irene’s calendar correctly?

Got it — I'll be on watch and will manually confirm Irene’s calendar overlay after Asha accepts. If the ICS still converts, I'll re-create the event in our GSuite with the explicit timezone set to CEST and invite the candidate by email.

Marissa Cole
Recruiting Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Asha Venkat <asha.venkat@gmail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:02:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Initial phone screen for Senior Engineer (30m)

Hi all —

10:30 CEST on Tue Jul 21 works for me. Please send the ICS with CEST explicitly set; I’ll accept once it arrives. I’ll be in a steady connection then (changed travel plan), so Google Meet is fine.

Thanks for accommodating the travel mix-up — looking forward to talking with Irene.

Best,
Asha
